summary: Server singleton of the target-history feature (esv::history::TargetSystem, EoCServer TargetHistorySystem.cpp): for every tracked target UUID the set of entities that were targeted and the entity that started the tracking. Alive in every idle level (context: nothing done), so the context did not narrow it down; the Toolkit's named TargetSystem::ProcessStartRequests did.

fields.name: Targets
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x5B7220 esv::history::TargetSystem::ProcessStartRequests (param_3 = this component): key = the request's Guid (Guid::GetHash, FUN_180227750 lookup at +0, bucket count at +8), value written into values array at +0x30 with stride 0x30 by copying the request's HashSet<EntityHandle> (FUN_18028ad60(values + idx*0x30, request+0x18)). bg3.exe destructor FUN_1422d3f60 destroys +0 with FUN_1405e19c0 (non-trivial values). Live: bucket counts 0xC07 / 0x3001 (primes), keys capacity 0x800..0x2000, size 0x689..0x1783.

fields.name: Requesters
fields.evidence: Same function: FUN_1803819d0(this+0x40, Guid) inserts the Guid key, FUN_180257a10(this+0x70, idx, request) stores the request's first qword (its EntityHandle, checked with the entity-handle validity test) as value. bg3.exe destructor frees +0x70 raw (trivial values) and the key set at +0x40 with FUN_140582ad0. Live sizes mirror the first map.
